name: Audio & Music
artwork: Original editable TinyCAD vector silhouettes, control surfaces and connector faces. No copied logos, product photography, traces or imported icon sets.
scope: Compact system-layout symbols for live sound, studios, recording, podcasts, worship and schools. Each labelled socket is one whole-cable endpoint, not individual electrical contacts. RF marks are explicit logical wireless links. Generic equipment layouts describe the listed sockets, not any specific brand/model. No SPICE or acoustic/firmware simulation.

references.title: Yamaha PA beginners: cables and connectors
references.facts: XLR, TRS/TS, RCA, USB and speaker-cable connector families; balanced mono and stereo TRS are distinct uses.

references.title: Yamaha band PA setup
references.facts: Microphones, guitars/bass, keyboard, DI boxes, mixers, powered mains and stage monitors.

references.title: Yamaha MG mixer overview
references.facts: Mono/stereo input strips and separate main, aux, monitor, group, record and headphone outputs; generic layouts do not reproduce a branded console.

references.title: Shure house-of-worship audio systems
references.facts: Microphone/instrument sources, mixing and processing, loudspeakers, recording/streaming and personal monitoring; mic, line and speaker levels are different.

references.title: Shure audio systems for music educators
references.facts: Recording and reinforcement share microphones/mixing; loudspeaker playback adds power amplification and signal processing.

references.title: Focusrite recording setup guide
references.facts: Computer, audio interface, DAW, microphones/instruments and headphones or monitor speakers.

references.title: Focusrite digital interface expansion
references.facts: ADAT and S/PDIF use different channel/protocol conventions; matching optical shapes do not establish compatibility.

references.title: MIDI Association TRS adapter specification
references.facts: MIDI DIN and mini-TRS interfaces; TRS Type A must be distinguished from legacy Type B.

references.title: MIDI 1.0 transport specification
references.facts: DIN5 serial MIDI transport; MIDI carries performance/control data, not an analogue audio signal.

references.title: Neutrik XLR connector FAQ
references.facts: Three-pole XLR is widely used for balanced professional audio. Connector-face artwork is not a conductor-level wiring symbol.

references.title: Allen & Heath AB168 getting-started guide
references.facts: Representative 16-input/8-output remote stagebox, paired input rows and separate return outputs. Stage-link protocols must match.

references.title: Rode podcast setup guide
references.facts: USB microphones, computer, headphones and additional phone/music sources in podcast production.

references.title: Radial direct-box overview
references.facts: Active/passive/stereo DI interfaces, instrument/line sources and balanced mic-level outputs.

references.title: Audinate Dante Controller overview
references.facts: Network audio devices/channels routed over a compatible Dante network.

references.title: Yamaha active and passive speakers
references.facts: Powered speakers accept line-level feeds; passive speakers require power-amplifier outputs. Monitor speakers serve performer monitoring.

sourceReview.decision: Fetched candidates are circuit symbols or generic mixer blocks. The requested equipment-layout resources use original physical silhouettes, complete-cable socket endpoints and compact control surfaces.
